nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-cursor package, describing how to install, verify, and uninstall the Cursor silent-capture shim that wires sessionStart, beforeSubmitPrompt, stop, and preCompact lifecycle hooks into hive-mind frames. Includes a capture fidelity table disclosing two degraded events (beforeSubmitPrompt is save-only, preCompact is observational).

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-cursor v0.1.0, declaring the Cursor silent-capture shim as a public ESM package with four named hook exports, a CLI binary entry point, and dependencies on @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-core and @waggle/hive-mind-shim-core.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares four named exports for individual hook files (session-start, user-prompt-submit, stop, pre-compact) alongside the default barrel, plus a bin entry for the cursor-hooks CLI installer.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript build configuration for the hive-mind-hooks-cursor package, extending the monorepo base config with composite project references to hive-mind-hooks-core and hive-mind-shim-core to enable incremental builds.

nodes.name: tsconfig.test.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript test-only compiler configuration for hive-mind-hooks-cursor, extending the base config with noEmit mode and including both src and tests directories without generating output artifacts.
